title: Add Service toast + Undo; Remove until invoiced; neither deletes a line
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Use Add Service and read the toast ('PM-A added · 4 lines', with Undo).
  2. Use Undo and confirm the row returns to Add Service and is no longer addressed.
  3. Add again, let the toast pass, then use Remove from the three-dot menu (before invoicing).
  4. Confirm Undo/Remove do not delete the already-added lines (deleted by hand, per the line's own state).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After Add Service a toast reads 'PM-A added · 4 lines' with Undo, for as long as the application's toasts stay.
  • Once it is gone, the row's three-dot menu offers Remove (until the work order is invoiced); Undo and Remove both return the row to Add Service and it is no longer addressed, so the step after invoicing does not list it.
  • Neither deletes a line: the lines already added stay on the work order and are deleted by hand; deleting the lines a service added does not unsatisfy that service.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R25: “After Add Service a toast reads PM-A added · 4 lines, with Undo, for as long as the application's toasts stay. Once it is gone, the row's three-dot menu offers Remove, for an Add Service made by mistake, until the work order is invoiced. Undo and Remove do the same: the row returns to Add Service and is no longer addressed on this work order, so the step after invoicing does not list it. Neither deletes a line. The lines already added stay on the work order, as any line does, and are deleted by hand, per S16-N4, because a line's own state decides whether it can be deleted”
  • S16-N4: “Deleting the lines a service added does not unsatisfy that service. The advisor's statement governs, not which lines happen to remain”
